market.summary: A modestly firmer start is expected: GIFT Nifty was about 25,260 (+0.3 to +0.4%) before the open after Friday's 0.6% fall. Overseas cues are soft: the Nasdaq fell 0.9% on Friday and Japan's Nikkei is down about 1.5% this morning after its Q3 GDP shrank. Foreign investors bought again on Friday (tenth straight day by these figures), Brent eased to about $95 and the rupee is near 94.2. Inflation above 6% keeps an RBI rate hike in play; WPI data is due today.

points.text: GIFT Nifty 25,264 (+93 points) at 8:23 IST; Nifty closed Friday at 25,144.30 (-0.61%).
US on Fri 13 Nov: S&P 500 -0.40% to 7,561.67, Nasdaq -0.91% to 25,136.27, Dow +0.10%. US futures steady ahead of Nvidia's results this week.
Asia Monday: Nikkei 225 down about 1.5% after a surprise fall in Japan's Q3 GDP; China's CSI 300 down about 1.1%.
Provisional cash flows 13 Nov: FIIs +Rs 5,737 Cr, DIIs -Rs 2,254 Cr; November to date FIIs +Rs 79,302 Cr, DIIs -Rs 49,089 Cr.
Brent about $95.2-95.8 (IEA sees a Q4 surplus as West Asia exports recover); rupee about 94.20 per dollar.
October CPI 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% ceiling; Morgan Stanley expects three more RBI hikes to a 6.25% terminal rate. Kotak sees Nifty support at 24,700-24,800 and resistance at 25,400.

market.watch: Whether the gap-up holds above Friday's 25,144 close; WPI print today; Nvidia results later this week for tech sentiment.

SEJALLTD.summary: New: on Saturday evening (14 Nov) Sejal Glass told NSE it has signed the business transfer agreement to buy Magnumtuff India's architectural and automotive glass business, the deal its board approved on 6 Nov. Terms as reported are unchanged (Rs 40.80 Cr lump sum incl. the Karnataka factory, Rs 36.2 Cr FY26 revenue, completion by 30 Nov), so this is the expected next step, mildly positive rather than a surprise. The price is still the issue: Rs 904.90 is only about 2% above cost and the 10 EMA, with strong hands WEAK.

points.text: NSE filing 14 Nov 18:23 / 18:32 IST: signing and execution of the business transfer agreement for Magnumtuff India's business undertaking (PDF could not be opened from this check; content from the filing summary).
